description: This file defines the LeaveTypeDao class, which provides data access methods for the LeaveType entity in the OrangeHRM leave management module. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching leave type records, as well as checking for employee allocations related to leave types.

classes.name: LeaveTypeDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for LeaveType entities, handling database operations such as retrieval, insertion, updating, deletion, and searching.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all non-deleted leave types, ordered by name.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeById
methods.description: Fetches a LeaveType entity by its unique ID.

methods.name: getExistingLeaveTypeIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of existing leave types filtered by an array of IDs, excluding deleted ones.

methods.name: saveLeaveType
methods.description: Persists a LeaveType entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteLeaveType
methods.description: Marks specified leave types as deleted based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getDeletedLeaveTypeList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of leave types that are marked as deleted.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeByName
methods.description: Fetches a leave type by its name, excluding deleted ones.

methods.name: undeleteLeaveType
methods.description: Restores a deleted leave type by setting its deleted flag to false.

methods.name: searchLeaveType
methods.description: Performs a search for leave types based on filter parameters, returning matching entities.

methods.name: getSearchLeaveTypePaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator object for searching leave types with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getSearchLeaveTypesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of leave types matching search filters.

methods.name: hasEmployeeAllocatedLeavesForLeaveType
methods.description: Checks if an employee has allocated leave requests for a specific leave type.
